sections.heading: Recommended background and strengths
sections.content: Look for someone with a user research background; research-operations experience is especially valuable, and UX experience is also a plus. They should know good research tactics and interviewing, and be able to create research toolkits and select prototyping and usability tools. Melissa emphasizes a process-oriented mindset: someone motivated to improve work by building systems and operationalizing it.

sections.heading: What that can look like
sections.content: Melissa describes research ops work such as building a participant database, maintaining research tools and toolkits, and training others to conduct good research. In compliance-sensitive settings, the team may certify people to do research within defined limits and handle studies that require additional user-researcher support. As an interview prompt, she suggests asking about a disliked work process the candidate tried to automate or systematize to make better.
